title: Cristaux (1970). Gribouillis et calculs divers : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not Grothendieck's own mathematics. It is a typewritten, mimeographed Bourbaki draft (header '- 77 -', 'n° 382'). It appears upside down in the scan, so the sheet was evidently reused as scrap paper for the handwritten crystalline/Lubin–Tate notes on the neighbouring pages.

The text is the opening of '§7. Jets. Opérateurs différentiels' of a draft on differential and analytic manifolds (C^r, with r finite, ∞ or ω, over K = R or C). Its content is as follows.

(1) Convention: r − k = r when r ∈ {∞, ω}, so the k-th derivatives of a C^r function are C^{r−k}.

(2) Definition 7.1.1: two germs f, g at x of morphisms X → Y with f(x) = g(x) = y have contact of order ≥ k at x if, in some (equivalently any) charts (U, φ, p) at x and (V, ψ, q) at y, the maps ψ∘f∘φ^{-1} and ψ∘g∘φ^{-1} have contact of order ≥ k at φ(x) ∈ K^p. This gives an equivalence relation on germs. A class is a k-jet with source x and target y, written j^k_x(f), also called the 'partie principale d'ordre k'. The notations J^k(X,Y), J^k_x(X,Y), J^k(X,Y)_y and J^k_x(X,Y)_y = J^k_x(X,Y) ∩ J^k(X,Y)_y are introduced.

(3) Definition 7.1.2: for Y = K one writes P^k(X), P^k_x(X), P^k_x(f). The algebra C^r_x(X) of germs of functions at x is introduced. The page breaks off just as it begins to state that P^k_x(X) has a unique K-algebra structure making the jet map C^r_x(X) → P^k_x(X) a homomorphism. That algebra is C^r_x(X)/m_x^{k+1}.

This is the standard foundational material that appears in Bourbaki's 'Variétés différentielles et analytiques. Fascicule de résultats' (§12, Jets). It has no relation to the Dieudonné-module / Lubin–Tate computations on the adjacent handwritten pages.
errors: No mathematical errors are visible. The phrase 'le symbole ∞ si r ≥ ∞' should be read as 'r = ∞ or ω', following Bourbaki's ordering convention ∞ < ω. The page is cut off mid-sentence.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a reused sheet of a mimeographed Bourbaki draft containing standard textbook definitions of jets. It is unrelated to Grothendieck's handwritten notes on the surrounding pages and contains nothing new.
transcription_corrections: The image is upside down. It is a typed Bourbaki draft (n° 382, p. 77) on the reverse of or interleaved with Grothendieck's manuscript, not a handwritten Grothendieck page.
The transcription itself is essentially accurate. The final sentence is truncated on the page ('telle que l'application ...').
